```{r}
# ============================================================
# SIMULATION-BASED POWER ANALYSIS
# HUMAN MILK EXPOSURE (Contact_BF) - vOTU PRESENCE
# RANDOM-SLOPE MODEL
# 100 MONTE CARLO SIMULATIONS
# ============================================================

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(simr)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("POWER ANALYSIS - HUMAN MILK EXPOSURE\n")
cat("Contact_BF: NO vs YES\n")
cat("RANDOM-SLOPE MODEL\n")
cat("100 SIMULATIONS\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# LOAD DATA -------------------------------------------------------------------

df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# BUILD FULL INFANT vOTU DATASET ----------------------------------------------

df_votu <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),

    subject = factor(subject),
    vOTUs = factor(vOTUs),

    timepoint_months = as.numeric(timepoint_months),

    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(
      scale(
        timepoint_months,
        center = TRUE,
        scale = TRUE
      )
    ),

    Contact_BF = factor(
      Contact_BF,
      levels = c("no", "yes")
    )
  )

# DATA CHECKS ------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Observations:", nrow(df_votu), "\n")
cat("vOTUs:", nlevels(df_votu$vOTUs), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", nlevels(df_votu$subject), "\n\n")

cat("Contact_BF levels:\n")
print(levels(df_votu$Contact_BF))

cat("\nNumber of unique samples by Contact_BF:\n")

print(
  df_votu %>%
    select(Sample, subject, Contact_BF) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    count(Contact_BF)
)

cat("\nContact_BF by timepoint:\n")

print(
  df_votu %>%
    select(Sample, subject, timepoint_months, Contact_BF) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    count(timepoint_months, Contact_BF)
)

# FIT RANDOM-SLOPE HUMAN MILK MODEL ----------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FITTING HUMAN MILK MODEL\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

fit_time <- system.time({

  model_contact_bf_randomslope <- glmer(
    presence ~ timepoint_scaled * Contact_BF +
      (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
      (1 | vOTUs),
    data = df_votu,
    family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

})

cat("\nModel fitted.\n")
print(fit_time)

cat("\nFixed effects:\n")
print(fixef(model_contact_bf_randomslope))

cat("\nCoefficient names:\n")
print(names(fixef(model_contact_bf_randomslope)))

cat("\nRandom effects:\n")
print(VarCorr(model_contact_bf_randomslope))

cat("\nSingular fit:\n")
print(isSingular(model_contact_bf_randomslope))

cat("\nConvergence messages:\n")
print(model_contact_bf_randomslope@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)

# SETTINGS ----------------------------------------------------------------------

NSIM <- 100
SEED <- 86420

# POWER ANALYSIS ----------------------------------------------------------------
#
# AGE x HUMAN MILK EXPOSURE
#
# Reference = Contact_BF "no"
#
# Tested coefficient:
# timepoint_scaled:Contact_BFyes

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("STARTING 100 SIMULATIONS\n")
cat("Effect: timepoint_scaled:Contact_BFyes\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

power_contact_bf_randomslope_100 <- powerSim(
  model_contact_bf_randomslope,
  test = fixed(
    "timepoint_scaled:Contact_BFyes",
    method = "z"
  ),
  nsim = NSIM,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = SEED
)

end_time <- Sys.time()


# RESULTS ------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("POWER ANALYSIS FINISHED\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(power_contact_bf_randomslope_100)

cat("\nStart time:\n")
print(start_time)

cat("\nEnd time:\n")
print(end_time)

cat("\nTotal elapsed time:\n")
print(end_time - start_time)

# SAVE MODEL AND RESULTS ----------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  here("results", "power_analysis"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  model_contact_bf_randomslope,
  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "model_contact_bf_randomslope.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  power_contact_bf_randomslope_100,
  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_contact_bf_randomslope_nsim100.rds"
  )
)

capture.output(
  summary(model_contact_bf_randomslope),
  file = here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "model_contact_bf_randomslope_summary.txt"
  )
)

capture.output(
  power_contact_bf_randomslope_100,
  file = here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_contact_bf_randomslope_nsim100.txt"
  )
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Date:", Sys.time()),
    paste("NSIM:", NSIM),
    paste("Seed:", SEED),

    paste(
      "Coefficient tested:",
      "timepoint_scaled:Contact_BFyes"
    ),

    paste(
      "Observed effect:",
      fixef(model_contact_bf_randomslope)[
        "timepoint_scaled:Contact_BFyes"
      ]
    ),

    paste(
      "Observations:",
      nobs(model_contact_bf_randomslope)
    ),

    paste(
      "vOTUs:",
      nlevels(model.frame(model_contact_bf_randomslope)$vOTUs)
    ),

    paste(
      "Subjects:",
      nlevels(model.frame(model_contact_bf_randomslope)$subject)
    ),

    paste(
      "Singular fit:",
      isSingular(model_contact_bf_randomslope)
    ),

    paste(
      "Model fitting elapsed seconds:",
      fit_time[["elapsed"]]
    ),

    paste("Start:", start_time),
    paste("End:", end_time),
    paste("Elapsed:", end_time - start_time)
  ),

  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_contact_bf_randomslope_nsim100_metadata.txt"
  )
)

cat("\nResults saved successfully.\n")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SIMULATION-BASED POWER ANALYSIS
# PLACE OF DELIVERY: HOME vs HOSPITAL
# MAIN RANDOM-SLOPE MODEL
# 100 MONTE CARLO SIMULATIONS
# ============================================================

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(simr)

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("POWER ANALYSIS - PLACE OF DELIVERY\n")
cat("HOME vs HOSPITAL\n")
cat("MAIN RANDOM-SLOPE MODEL\n")
cat("100 SIMULATIONS\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

# LOAD DATA ---------------------------------------------------------------------

df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# BUILD INFANT vOTU DATASET -----------------------------------------------------

df_votu <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    presence = if_else(CPM > 0, 1L, 0L),

    subject = factor(subject),
    vOTUs = factor(vOTUs),

    timepoint_months = as.numeric(timepoint_months),
    timepoint_scaled = as.numeric(scale(timepoint_months)),

    delivery = factor(delivery),

    # Place of delivery
    place_delivery = case_when(
      delivery == "homebirth" ~ "home",
      delivery %in% c("csection", "vaginal") ~ "hospital",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # Hospital is reference
    place_delivery = factor(
      place_delivery,
      levels = c("hospital", "home")
    )
  )

# CHECK CODING --------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("Observations:", nrow(df_votu), "\n")
cat("vOTUs:", nlevels(df_votu$vOTUs), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", nlevels(df_votu$subject), "\n\n")

cat("Place of delivery levels:\n")
print(levels(df_votu$place_delivery))

cat("\nNumber of subjects by place of delivery:\n")

print(
  df_votu %>%
    select(subject, place_delivery) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    count(place_delivery)
)

cat("\nNumber of samples by place of delivery:\n")

print(
  df_votu %>%
    select(Sample, subject, place_delivery) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    count(place_delivery)
)

# FIT MODEL ------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("FITTING PLACE OF DELIVERY MODEL\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

fit_time <- system.time({

  model_place_delivery <- glmer(
    presence ~ timepoint_scaled * place_delivery +
      (1 + timepoint_scaled | subject) +
      (1 | vOTUs),
    data = df_votu,
    family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )

})

cat("\nModel fitted.\n")
print(fit_time)

cat("\nFixed effects:\n")
print(fixef(model_place_delivery))

cat("\nCoefficient names:\n")
print(names(fixef(model_place_delivery)))

cat("\nRandom effects:\n")
print(VarCorr(model_place_delivery))

cat("\nSingular fit:\n")
print(isSingular(model_place_delivery))

cat("\nConvergence messages:\n")
print(model_place_delivery@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)

# POWER SETTINGS ---------------------------------------------------------------------

NSIM <- 100
SEED <- 13579

# POWER ANALYSIS ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# TIME × PLACE OF DELIVERY
# Hospital = reference
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("STARTING 100 SIMULATIONS\n")
cat("Effect: timepoint_scaled:place_deliveryhome\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

start_time <- Sys.time()

power_place_delivery_100 <- powerSim(
  model_place_delivery,
  test = fixed(
    "timepoint_scaled:place_deliveryhome",
    method = "z"
  ),
  nsim = NSIM,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = SEED
)

end_time <- Sys.time()

# RESULTS ---------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("POWER ANALYSIS FINISHED\n")
cat("========================================\n\n")

print(power_place_delivery_100)

cat("\nStart time:\n")
print(start_time)

cat("\nEnd time:\n")
print(end_time)

cat("\nTotal elapsed time:\n")
print(end_time - start_time)

# SAVE RESULTS ---------------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  here("results", "power_analysis"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  model_place_delivery,
  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "model_place_delivery_MAIN.rds"
  )
)

saveRDS(
  power_place_delivery_100,
  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_place_delivery_nsim100.rds"
  )
)

capture.output(
  summary(model_place_delivery),
  file = here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "model_place_delivery_MAIN_summary.txt"
  )
)

capture.output(
  power_place_delivery_100,
  file = here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_place_delivery_nsim100.txt"
  )
)

writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Date:", Sys.time()),
    paste("NSIM:", NSIM),
    paste("Seed:", SEED),

    paste(
      "Coefficient tested:",
      "timepoint_scaled:place_deliveryhome"
    ),

    paste(
      "Observed effect:",
      fixef(model_place_delivery)[
        "timepoint_scaled:place_deliveryhome"
      ]
    ),

    paste(
      "Observations:",
      nobs(model_place_delivery)
    ),

    paste(
      "vOTUs:",
      nlevels(model.frame(model_place_delivery)$vOTUs)
    ),

    paste(
      "Subjects:",
      nlevels(model.frame(model_place_delivery)$subject)
    ),

    paste(
      "Singular fit:",
      isSingular(model_place_delivery)
    ),

    paste(
      "Model fitting elapsed seconds:",
      fit_time[["elapsed"]]
    ),

    paste("Start:", start_time),
    paste("End:", end_time),
    paste("Elapsed:", end_time - start_time)
  ),

  here(
    "results",
    "power_analysis",
    "power_place_delivery_nsim100_metadata.txt"
  )
)

cat("\nResults saved successfully.\n")
````
